name: richos-phone-probe
description: The half-day device probe from docs/plans/richos-phone-client-2026-09-18.md §3.2 — five checks on the CEO's iPhone, one page, no product code.
comment:dependencies: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Node's own crypto covers ECDH P-256, HKDF-SHA256, AES-128-GCM and raw-format ECDSA signing, so RFC 8291 + RFC 8292 need no package; node:http and node:fs serve the page. The reasoning, including why the web-push package was not used, is at the top of lib/webpush.js.
